title: Iron Psycho: RETRO
description:
In Iron Psycho: RETRO, you are a scifi-futuristic soldier aboard a ship infested with insectoids and croco-aliens. Your duty is to clear the ship of the threat. Fight your way through 5 levels collecting keys and eliminating enemies in your way.



The game features:



Singleplayer Campaign containing 5 levels.



All campaign levels contain various secrets.





3 Weapons:



-Shotgun, Pistol, SMG





6 Different Enemies:



-Grasshopperman



-Roachman



-Crawlers



-Flying grasshopper girl



-Croco-aliens



-Croco-alien leader
description_short: Iron Psycho: RETRO is a retro First-Person shooter in which the player must eliminate all threats aboard the ship and collect keys to reach the end of each level. Some levels contain secrets.
